editorial:
This is a place for essays, reflections and stories. A point of view is not a claim to have the final answer.

## What the labels mean

I distinguish interpretive essays, devotional or personal reflections, and illustrative stories. An Essay label does not by itself mean a piece reports original research. The short note on a post explains its basis.

## Sources and examples

I identify hypothetical examples as illustrative. Sources are linked where they support a factual or historical claim. A source for a philosophical text does not prove a modern workplace outcome. If a claim needs better support, I welcome a correction rather than treating confident wording as evidence.

## Revisions and corrections

I retain original publication dates. Substantive editorial changes carry an updated date and a revision note on the article. This edition, reviewed on 16 October 2026, removed Word export markup, revised summaries, softened unsupported claims in the Socrates essay and made the series examples more concrete.

## AI-assisted work

AI tools assisted the technical cleanup and editorial revisions in this edition. That assistance does not independently verify factual claims. The distinction between interpretation, illustration and supporting evidence still matters.

## The archive and its series

The most recent original publication in the current collection is dated 31 July 2026. The 31-part Bhaja Govindam collection is complete. The homepage offers a selection across subjects rather than presenting the final series instalment as a starting point. A series is one thread through the writing, rather than the identity of the site.

## Independence and contact

The views are my own. An employer, organisation or book mentioned here is not endorsing the writing. I use my sriramadvisory.com email address for correspondence about this personal site. My LinkedIn profile gives the professional context. Please use Contact for questions or corrections.
privacy:
This website has no advertising, analytics scripts, tracking pixels, public accounts or contact-submission database.

## Reading the site

The website does not set tracking cookies. The hosting provider may process technical request information, such as IP addresses, for delivery and security. That processing is subject to the hosting provider's policies.

## Contact and message drafts

The contact composer keeps the draft in the current browser page. It does not send the draft to this website or save it after the page is closed. Copying uses the browser clipboard. Choosing Gmail or Outlook opens a draft with that provider; the provider then handles the address and message under its own policies. You decide whether to send it. Email correspondence is handled in the chosen email service. Please do not include sensitive information.

## Email updates

Email signup is not active until a newsletter service is connected. No email addresses are collected through a disabled signup option. When enabled, the signup form sends the email address directly to Buttondown for confirmation and subscription management. Confirmation and unsubscribe instructions are provided by that service; the website does not keep its own subscriber database.

## External links

LinkedIn, email services and other linked websites have their own privacy practices. Share links open the selected service only when clicked. This website does not embed social feeds or third-party editing scripts.
